[[File:Dstcargobarge.jpg|thumb|The type of cargo barge used to support the Death Star I.]]
'''Cargo barges''' were spaceships used to transport large amounts of goods.

==History==
Thirteen thousand cargo barges served as support craft for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]], each equipped with two twin [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].
Specific classes included the [[Eliall-class Cargo Barge|''Eliall''-class cargo barge]] and the [[Nyubba-class cargo barge driver|''Nyubba''-class cargo barge driver]]. Cargo barges also orbited [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], under which members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] hid their [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] immediately prior to the [[Battle over Coruscant]].
